newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes lower on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes lower on dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed down against the dollar on Wednesday after the U.S. currency rallied later in the day, dealers said.
The rupee closed slightly lower at 56.71 to the dollar after opening at 56.67. It closed at 56.70 on Monday, the last working day in 1996. Overnight call money closed at 16 percent.

"Most multinationals and private firms were closed today too for the holidays, so it was not a very active day," a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said. "But there was some genuine demand for import covering."
The Central Bank pushed down the dollar by 0.75 local cents, and set buying and selling prices at 56.1305 and 57.2645 rupees.
